visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up view focuses on a human wrist showing a faint red scratch, moving toward a metallic door handle. The hand grips the silver handle and pulls, swinging the wooden door inward to reveal a tiled interior floor. No people are seen yet. (2) As the camera enters the shop-like environment, two corgis are discovered lying on the light-colored floor tiles. One corgi in the foreground sits up, looking directly at the lens with an expectant facial expression, while the other remains lying down further back. (3) The scene shifts to a young girl with brown, wavy hair tied in a small top-knot, sitting on a black chair. She wears a white and grey fleece vest over pink trousers. She gazes at the camera with a calm, neutral expression. (4) The girl stands up and walks toward the corgis. On the left, a man in a brown shirt and grey pants is seated on a stool next to stacks of green plastic crates and cardboard boxes. The lighting is bright and natural. (5) A close-up shows the man's hands using silver scissors to cut a dark brown, stick-like dog treat. Both corgis are now standing and looking up at the man's hands with open mouths and wagging tails, showing high excitement. (6) The girl takes the cut pieces and extends her hand to the dogs. She tosses a piece onto the floor, and the closer corgi snaps it up. The background shows a storefront with various goods on shelves and a clear view of the street outside.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A slice-of-life vlog documenting the owner's interaction with their two corgis and daughter. The video starts with the owner surprising the dogs from their nap and transitions into the daughter helping to feed them treats prepared by a family friend ('Onion Uncle').
